messages.subject: problem with ylab under Mac Snow Leopard
parts:
# developed a multi-colored ribbon plot to illustrate call center performance
# working under Mac Snow Leopard OS X 10.6.4
# and R 2.11.1 GUI 1.34 Leopard build 32-bit (5589)
# everything is working fine except for labels on the vertical axis
# why does xlab work but not ylab?
# here is the code....

library(ggplot2)

x.hour <- seq(from=0,to=23)
ymax.bottomwhite <- ymin.percentile <- c(8.0,8.5,6.0,10.0,11.0,15.0,8.5,8.0,12.0,11.0,11.0,10.0,10.0,10.0,16.0,14.0,11.0,11.0,11.0,11.5,8.0,6.0,8.0,5.5)
ymin.topwhite <- ymax.percentile <- c(15.03333,15.23333,10.33333,13.00000,12.00000,18.00000,19.01667,12.96667,21.00000,20.00000,20.91667,20.20000,19.85000,15.91667,24.86667,21.01667,19.95000,24.96667,17.75000,18.10000,15.50000,11.00000,11.20000,8.00000)

ymin.bottomwhite <- greenmin <- rep(0,length=24)
greenmax <- rep(15,length=24)

yellowmin <- rep(15,length=24)
yellowmax <- rep(20,length=24)

redmin <- rep(20,length=24)
ymax.topwhite <- redmax <- rep(30,length=24)

words.for.plot.title <- "Call Center Wait-Time Report \n(Displayed Range is 50th to 85th Percentiles)"

ggobject <- ggplot() + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=greenmin, ymax=greenmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="darkgreen")  + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=yellowmin, ymax=yellowmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="yellow")  + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=redmin, ymax=redmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="red")   + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=ymin.topwhite, ymax=ymax.topwhite), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="white")      + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=ymin.bottomwhite, ymax=ymax.bottomwhite), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="white")  + xlab("Hour of Day (24-Hour Clock)")  + ylab("Call Center Wait-Time (Seconds)") + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=15)) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=20)) + opts(title = words.for.plot.title) + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + scale_y_continuous("", limits = c(0, 30)) 

print(ggobject)

messages.subject: Re: problem with ylab under Mac Snow Leopard
parts:
Tom, 

You have two calls in your plot that specify the title of the Y axis. 

#you forgot to define your dataframe
demand.calls.data.frame<-data.frame(x.hour, greenmin, greenmax, yellowmin, yellowmax, ymin.topwhite, ymax.topwhite, ymin.bottomwhite, ymax.bottomwhite)

#

ggplot() + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=greenmin, ymax=greenmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="darkgreen")  + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=yellowmin, ymax=yellowmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="yellow")  + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=redmin, ymax=redmax), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="red")   + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=ymin.topwhite, ymax=ymax.topwhite), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="white")      + geom_ribbon(data=demand.calls.data.frame, mapping=aes(x=x.hour, ymin=ymin.bottomwhite, ymax=ymax.bottomwhite), stat="identity",colour="white",fill="white")  + xlab("Hour of Day (24-Hour Clock)")  + ylab("Call Center Wait-Time (Seconds)") + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=15)) + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=20)) + opts(title = words.for.plot.title) + theme_bw(base_size = 12) + scale_y_continuous("", limits = c(0, 30))

When you have "" you are erasing your title. Put your title in the scale_y_continuous() call and you should see it. Then your ylab() call is redundant of course. 

Brandon
